sourceCheckSample.scope: All logged priority store-check series in the shared inventory sample used by PickupChecker.
sourceCheckSample.timingDefinition: Consecutive logged check-completion timestamps for the same anonymous store series; one completion per store check cycle; unsuccessful checks retained. Not network-request duration or device notification latency.
limitations: Publisher-produced observation, not an independent audit.
A fixed 30-minute sample, not a historical uptime guarantee.
The first check in each series has no preceding interval within this window.
Unlogged or incomplete work is not reconstructable; store-level checks do not prove each SKU or every member target was checked.
No store identities, watch rules, customer data or infrastructure details are included.

provenance: Source check sample is shared with PickupChecker; not an independent RestockWire member-target trial. Site freshness is a separate RestockWire observation.
